40: def Isometry [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] (f : α → β) : Prop :=
41:   ∀ x1 x2 : α, edist (f x1) (f x2) = edist x1 x2
42: 
43: /-- On pseudometric spaces, a map is an isometry if and only if it preserves nonnegative
44: distances. -/
45: theorem isometry_iff_nndist_eq [PseudoMetricSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] {f : α → β} :
46:     Isometry f ↔ ∀ x y, nndist (f x) (f y) = nndist x y := by
47:   simp only [Isometry, edist_nndist, ENNReal.coe_inj]
48: 
49: /-- On pseudometric spaces, a map is an isometry if and only if it preserves distances. -/
50: theorem isometry_iff_dist_eq [PseudoMetricSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] {f : α → β} :
51:     Isometry f ↔ ∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) = dist x y := by
52:   simp only [isometry_iff_nndist_eq, ← coe_nndist, NNReal.coe_inj]
53: 
54: /-- An isometry preserves distances. -/
55: alias ⟨Isometry.dist_eq, _⟩ := isometry_iff_dist_eq
56: 
57: /-- A map that preserves distances is an isometry -/

by_cases hpos : 0 < dimH E
· exact h_T022 hpos
· have hzero : dimH E = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) bot_le
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := h_H002
  rcases h_T008 with ⟨hbound, hfin, hbdd, hR, hc, hn, hbij, hjoin, hinv, hdist⟩
  let f : unitI → V (n+1) := fun t => join x₀ (t : ℝ)
  have hf : Isometry f := by
    apply isometry_iff_dist_eq.mpr
    intro t u
    have hs : dist (f t) (f u) ^ 2 = dist (t : ℝ) (u : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [f, dist_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_add] using
        hdist x₀ x₀ (t : ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    change dist (f t) (f u) = dist (t : ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    nlinarith [dist_nonneg (f t) (f u), dist_nonneg (t : ℝ) (u : ℝ)]
  have hsub : Set.range f ⊆ cylinder E := by
    rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
    change base (join x₀ (t : ℝ)) ∈ E ∧ height (join x₀ (t : ℝ)) ∈ unitI
    rw [(hjoin x₀ (t : ℝ)).1, (hjoin x₀ (t : ℝ)).2]
    exact ⟨hx₀, t.property⟩
  have heq : dimH (Set.range f) = dimH unitI :=
    (h_T004.2.2.1.isometry unitI f hf).1
  have hmono : dimH (Set.range f) ≤ dimH (cylinder E) :=
    h_T004.2.2.1.mono (Set.range f) (cylinder E) hsub
  rw [heq, h_T026.2.2.2] at hmono
  simpa only [hzero, zero_add] using hmono
